title: On an existing purchase order, Add item shows the inactive message as the field error on Tab out
custom_preconds: QA env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop), location Staging Heavy Duty. Logged in as Admin. QAPL-I1 is inactive here. The open purchase order at Staging Heavy Duty with QAPL-T2 lines (note its line count).
custom_steps:
1. Open the open purchase order and click Add item.
  2. In the part field type "QAPL-I1".
  3. Press Tab to leave the part field.
  4. Clear the field, type "qapl i1" (lower case, a space for the hyphen) and press Tab at once.
  5. Fill the other required fields (e.g. quantity 1) and try to add the item.
  6. Close the Add item form without saving and reload the purchase order.
custom_expected:
1. The Add item form opens with an empty part field.
  2. The dropdown shows "QAPL-I1 is inactive. Activate it from the Inactive tab to use it." in place of the special-order offer. QAPL-I1 is not offered as a part, and no special-order or "Create ... as a new part" option shows.
  3. The same text "QAPL-I1 is inactive. Activate it from the Inactive tab to use it." stays under the part field as its error.
  4. After a moment the field error names the stocked number: "QAPL-I1 is inactive. Activate it from the Inactive tab to use it."
  5. The item is not added: the form does not submit, or the server refuses it with "QAPL-I1 is inactive. Activate it from the Inactive tab to use it.".
  6. The purchase order's lines are unchanged (same count); no QAPL-I1 line exists.
